limitations: A 200 status and .XLSX/.PDF URL did not return the requested data; returned HTML is treated as an access/interstitial failure, not as evidence.

Table 218 publishes cut-off price/yield, not the weighted-average price for retail non-competitive allotment. RBI rules state retail NCB allocation uses the weighted-average successful competitive price, unavailable from this table alone.
A sample spanning 50 auctions does not establish a complete multi-year rolling T-bill total-return series; no investor-specific bid/allotment/funding/fees/tax path is reconstructed.
This source does not qualify dated GoI bond secondary-market total-return or reinvested coupon return.
